prompt: Ship the refund-ledger change as a rolling PostgreSQL deployment. Multiple application versions may run concurrently. Preserve createServer(options), whose payments option contains {id, owner, amountCents}; implement POST /payments/:id/refunds using Bearer account authentication, an integer amountCents, and Idempotency-Key. A refund cannot exceed the payment's unrefunded amount, another account must not learn whether a payment exists, and a retry must return the original refund. Add ordered up-migrations without rewriting 001, add regression tests, and make the tag release build one immutable artifact after tests with a documented literal rollback command.

assertions.description: The rolling migration is additive and enforces ledger invariants
Authentication, ownership, and amount validation are enforced
Retries are stable and total refunds cannot exceed the payment
Client failures are structured without internal leakage
The project test command exercises the refund boundary and passes
Tag release tests first and publishes the exact artifact built once
Operators receive an executable rollback command
